purpose: Freeze privacy-safe file-change evidence shapes before introducing the Provider-neutral domain contract.
versionPolicy: Versions identify evidence provenance only. They are not runtime gates.
privacyContract: No prompt or model response body
No credential, token, environment value, or stderr
No real filesystem path, command, or user file content
All session, turn, item, tool, event, and request identifiers are placeholders
Schema-constructed evidence is never labelled as a real runtime capture

fixtures.scenario: Successful ACP Edit with repeated diff content at completion
Successful stream-json Edit and Write tool lifecycles
A successful filesystem mutation represented only by commandExecution
Local session JSONL patch_apply_end records for update, add, and delete
Schema-valid fileChange lifecycle and turn-level aggregate fallback
